[[Mungri Magicbox]] is a [[Dredge]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Ferndale]] [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Ferndale}}

== Quests ==
* [[Mungri Magicbox (Zaishen quest)]]

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Boon Signet}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Life Bond}}
* {{Skill icon|Reversal of Fortune}}
* {{Skill icon|Shield Guardian}}
* {{Skill icon|Shielding Hands}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Dredge Garment]]
* [[Dredge Incisor]]
* [[Mungri's Flame]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* The boss [[spawn]]s with another [[Dredge Gardener]] and can be very hard to kill.
* [[Scourge Healing]] and [[Scourge Enchantment]] help to turn the battle in your favor.
* It is recommended to bring skills that [[punish]] and/or remove [[enchantment]]s or skills like [[Backfire]], [[Visions of Regret]] and [[Spirit Shackles]] to lower his energy and health fast.
* This boss is found in an area with lots of [[patrol]]ling groups of Dredge.  Be sure to clear these groups out individually before engaging this boss, as these patrols can quickly stack numbers against you.
